title: Application initialises the Sentry SDK
explanation: Application code calls sentry_sdk.init(), which sends errors and performance data to the configured Sentry DSN. Without a DSN it's a no-op, but a DSN in code or in SENTRY_DSN makes it phone home.
fix: Remove the Sentry SDK from the air-gapped build, or point it at a Sentry instance inside the enclave.
